description: Defines intrusive doubly linked list structures and iterators for managing Node lists within the Torch JIT graph representation, including iterator operations and list traversal methods.

classes.name: generic_graph_node_list
classes.description: Intrusive doubly linked list for Node objects with sentinel nodes and bidirectional iteration.

classes.name: generic_graph_node_list_iterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing the intrusive Node list, supporting forward and reverse iteration, and node destruction.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Forward declaration of Node class used in list structures.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Returns iterator to the first element in the list.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns iterator to the position past the last element in the list.

methods.name: rbegin
methods.description: Returns reverse iterator to the last element.

methods.name: rend
methods.description: Returns reverse iterator to the position before the first element.

methods.name: reverse
methods.description: Returns a reversed version of the list.

methods.name: front
methods.description: Returns pointer to the first node.

methods.name: back
methods.description: Returns pointer to the last node.
